unit.title: Quadratic Functions and Models
unit.act: Act IX - One nonlinear object, several useful forms
unit.role: Connect quadratic equations to parabola geometry, modeling, and optimization.
unit.governingQuestion: What does each algebraic form reveal about a parabola?
unit.storyArc: The same quadratic appears in standard, factored, and vertex forms. Students learn to choose a form based on the information needed, then use parabolas for modeling, inequalities, and regression.
outcomes: Identify vertex, axis, intercepts, opening, and extremum.
Interpret standard, factored, and vertex forms.
Solve quadratic inequalities and critique quadratic fits.
unit.investigation: Build and optimize an area, revenue, or projectile model and interpret all mathematically valid roots.
unit.mastery: Students select and convert forms, graph from structure, solve inequalities, and interpret an optimum with units.
